A '''biological converter''' was a type of [[chemical converter]], a component of a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Life support/Legends|life support]] system. It converted waste material such as [[Carbon dioxide/Legends|carbon dioxide]] as part of the vessel's [[Atmospheric converter/Legends|atmosphere-generator]].<ref name="SWS" />
